blockingIssues.description: VAL-PARITY-001 coverage does not compare normalized pre- vs post-mutation frame/scene output for the unchanged sibling, so a regression that changes unchanged sibling geometry or color in both paths could still pass.
VAL-PARITY-003 coverage does not compare exact frame-vs-scene scroll delta or indicator geometry, so scene-path scroll-distance or indicator-placement regressions could still pass.
Focused ScenePainter evidence required for VAL-PARITY-004 and VAL-PARITY-005 is still missing for replayed deferred overlays and nested deferred subtree ordering on the scene path.
VAL-PARITY-009 coverage still stops at focus/activation routing and does not prove deferred draggable and scrollable ancestor routing.

appliedUpdates.description: Added an architecture note that deferred-subtree scene semantics depend on runtime-owned prepaint state, so raw ScenePainter.paint() is not a complete standalone harness for deferred-subtree replay and ancestor-routing assertions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Make the `.factory/library/user-testing.md` startup read conditional instead of mandatory for pure runtime/parity harness work, or document why it is still required.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review reports for normalized-frame-scene-output-and-scroll-parity and prepaint-ancestor-routing-and-pacing-parity both observed that workers completed runtime-only parity-test work without using user-testing context and skipped that step in their transcripts.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that deferred-subtree scene behavior depends on runtime-owned prepaint state, so raw `ScenePainter.paint()` is insufficient for deferred-subtree replay or ancestor-routing assertions without runtime integration.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The deferred-replay-and-backend-switch-parity review found the worker added and removed ScenePainter tests after discovering standalone ScenePainter.paint() could not exercise deferred subtree behavior that the contract expected to validate.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require workers to source commit IDs for handoffs from `git rev-parse HEAD` (or equivalent) instead of manually copied hashes before calling EndFeatureRun.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The prepaint-ancestor-routing-and-pacing-parity review found the handoff stored a non-resolving full commit SHA and the reviewer had to re-resolve the actual commit from git history.

rejectedObservations.observation: The earlier duplicate parity-test block in prepaint-ancestor-routing-and-pacing-parity should remain a blocking review finding.
rejectedObservations.reason: rejected because scrutiny validation removed the duplicate block from the current working tree and the re-review no longer found it.
